An explosion that deals <pve 676 /> <pvp [120 against Players, 250 against Constructs] /> <solar Solar /> damage in an 8 meter radius. Has no Damage Falloff in PvE, but has Damage Falloff in PvP.

Removes all <solar Scorch /> and prevents it from being reapplied for 1.6 seconds.

Damage can benefit from certain damage increases carried by the initial <solar Scorch /> source. For example, a <solar Fusion Grenade /> with <exotic Verity's Brow /> at 5 stacks grants 100% increased <solar Ignition /> damage. Melee damage increases do not affect <solar Ignition /> or <solar Scorch /> damage.

<solar Ignition /> damage stuns <link Unstoppable Champions [#CombatantClassifications] />.

source.text:
Explosion that deals 676 [120 Guardians | 250 Construct] Solar Damage in a 8 meter radius without [with] damage falloff. 
Ignitions remove all Scorch, and incur a 1.6 second cooldown before Scorch can be reapplied. 

Ignition damage can be increased through certain damage increases if the initial Scorch source had a damage increase.
Eg: Verity's Brow x5 + Fusion Grenade = 100% Increased Ignition Damage.
Melee Damage Buffs do not scale Ignition nor Scorch damage.

Unstoppable Champions become Stunned upon receiving Ignition damage.
